incident.title: AI chatbot gave incorrect medical dosage advice to patient
incident.description: Healthcare chatbot deployed by MedAssist Corp (powered by GPT-5) recommended doubling a patient's blood thinner dosage without disclaimers.

events.description: Patient asks about blood thinner dosage adjustment
GPT-5 recommends doubling the dose without disclaimer
Patient takes doubled dose
Patient hospitalised with bleeding complications

incident.title: Autonomous trading bot caused $4.2M loss on misinterpreted signal
incident.description: AI trading system deployed by QuantEdge Capital misinterpreted a Fed announcement as bearish, opened massive leveraged short position. Human oversight was configured but kill-switch threshold was set too high.

events.description: Fed announces rate decision — AI interprets as strongly bearish
Trading bot opens $4.2M leveraged short on S&P futures
Kill-switch threshold not triggered (set at $5M)
Market rallies 2.3% — position underwater
Margin call triggers forced liquidation at maximum loss

incident.title: AI legal assistant hallucinated contract clause causing £620K loss
incident.description: LegalMind AI (deployed by Baker & Sterling LLP) generated a merger agreement containing a fabricated non-compete exemption clause. The client relied on this clause in negotiations, which was later invalidated in arbitration.

events.description: Associate requests AI draft of merger non-compete clause
AI generates clause citing non-existent 'Thornton v. Meridian (2019)' exemption
Senior partner approves draft without verifying cited precedent
Arbitration panel invalidates clause — client loses negotiating position

incident.title: Autonomous vehicle failed to detect and brake for pedestrian
incident.description: Level 4 self-driving taxi operated by RideAuto GmbH (Wayve perception stack) failed to detect a pedestrian in a marked crosswalk during rain. Contributing factors: sensor occlusion from water droplets and a regression in the latest perception model update.

events.description: Heavy rain causes partial LiDAR point cloud degradation
Perception model classifies pedestrian as static object (confidence 0.31)
Planning module does not initiate emergency braking
Vehicle strikes pedestrian at 38 km/h in marked crosswalk

incident.title: AI copilot introduced SQL injection vulnerability exploited in production
incident.description: GitHub Copilot suggested an unparameterised SQL query for a user search endpoint. The developer at TechStartup Inc accepted the suggestion. Code passed peer review and shipped. Attacker exploited the SQLi within 48 hours, exfiltrating 340K user records.

events.description: Copilot suggests unparameterised SQL query for /api/users/search
Developer accepts suggestion without modification
Peer reviewer approves PR — misses SQL injection pattern
Vulnerable code deployed to production
Attacker exploits SQLi — exfiltrates 340K user records

incident.title: AI claims system systematically denied valid disability insurance claims
incident.description: InsureAI deployed by National Coverage Ltd automatically denied 2,300 valid disability claims over 6 months. The model was trained on historical data that reflected human adjudicator bias against certain conditions. Affected claimants suffered financial hardship.

events.description: InsureAI Claims Engine v2 deployed without bias audit
System begins denying valid claims at 3x historical rate
Quality assurance team fails to flag anomalous denial rate for 3 months
Class action filed on behalf of 2,300 wrongly denied claimants

incident.title: NHS-deployed radiology AI misclassified malignant tumour as benign — 11-month delay in cancer diagnosis
incident.description: RadioMind CADx (FDA 510(k) cleared, MHRA-registered Class IIa SaMD) deployed by Northern NHS Trust as a second-reader on chest CT scans labelled an 18mm spiculated nodule BENIGN with confidence 0.94. The reporting registrar concurred without escalation. 11 months later, the same patient presented symptomatically; the nodule had grown to 47mm and metastasised to mediastinal nodes (stage IIIa lung adenocarcinoma).

events.description: RadioMind CADx returns label=BENIGN, confidence=0.94 on 18mm spiculated nodule
Confidence threshold for MALIGNANT classification = 0.62; nodule spiculation feature weight not exposed to reviewer
Reporting registrar concurs with AI label without independent feature analysis (automation bias documented)
Radiology report signed off; no follow-up imaging scheduled
Patient presents symptomatically; same nodule now 47mm, metastatic stage IIIa adenocarcinoma
MHRA Yellow Card serious adverse event filed; clinical negligence claim opened by patient

incident.title: Level-4 robotaxi misclassified stationary fire truck on I-280, rear-ended at 71 mph — one fatality, NHTSA SCI opened
incident.description: A SAE Level-4 robotaxi operated by FleetCo LLC under RobotaxiCo software v8.3 was travelling at 71 mph on I-280 northbound in clear daylight. A fire truck stationary in the right lane with hazard lights active was classified by the perception stack as 'overhead gantry / non-driveable structure' (confidence 0.77). The planner did not engage emergency braking until 0.8s before impact.

events.description: Clear daylight, dry asphalt, fire truck stationary with hazard lights and rear strobe pattern active
Perception classifies fire truck as 'overhead gantry / non-driveable' (label confidence 0.77)
Planner maintains 71 mph cruise speed; no lane change considered
Automated emergency braking engages 0.8s before impact (insufficient stopping distance)
Robotaxi strikes rear of fire truck at 68 mph; one occupant fatality, two firefighters injured
NHTSA opens SCI-2026-117; Cal DMV deactivates FleetCo Level-4 permit pending review

incident.title: Image diffusion model regurgitated NYT Pulitzer Prize photograph near-verbatim on third-party prompt
incident.description: PixelForge Foundation v2.4 (a 12B-parameter image diffusion model) was trained on the LAION-FullArchive-2025 dataset, which included paywalled New York Times Company photographic archives obtained via residential-proxy scraping. A downstream API customer (StudioGen Inc.) used the model in production; a user prompt 'Pulitzer 2019 firefighters Notre-Dame' generated an image with >0.94 cosine similarity to the registered 2019 Pulitzer winner.

events.description: LAION-FullArchive-2025 ingested for pre-training; NYT paywalled archives included without licence
PixelForge Foundation v2.4 released as commercial API
End-user issues prompt 'Pulitzer 2019 firefighters Notre-Dame'
Generated image has cosine similarity 0.94 to registered 2019 Pulitzer photograph (perceptual hash distance < 4)
StudioGen Inc. publishes derivative image in client marketing campaign without further review
The New York Times Company files S.D.N.Y. complaint citing 17 U.S.C. §§ 501, 504(c); seeks injunction

incident.title: Robo-adviser systematically mis-sold high-fee growth fund to 612 retail clients in breach of suitability + Consumer Duty
incident.description: NestEgg Wealth Ltd (FCA-authorised, dual-licensed by ASIC) deployed an in-house recommendation model (NestEgg Recommender v4) that took a 50-question risk profile and returned a portfolio allocation. Audit reconstruction showed the model assigned a fixed 38% weight to the in-house 'NestEgg Growth Plus' fund (TER 1.8%) regardless of whether the client's stated risk tolerance was Cautious, Balanced, or Growth.

events.description: NestEgg Recommender v4 promoted to production without independent suitability audit
Audit reconstruction shows fixed 38% weight to 'NestEgg Growth Plus' across all risk tolerances
612 retail clients invest ~AUD $34M based on the recommendation
Six-month drawdown averages 22%; client complaints to FOS rise 9x baseline
FCA opens enforcement under PRIN 2A (Consumer Duty) and SMCR
ASIC opens parallel investigation under s912A(1)(a) Corporations Act for AU feeder fund clients
